text:
sam: heads-up — after yesterday's delegation rollout we started seeing quota attribution spikes for a subset of requests. looks like delegated metadata isn't being normalized before routing :thinking_face:

nina: ugh. saw the alert in the quota dashboard at 03:10 UTC. a bunch of orgs got charged under the proxy service key instead of the originating project.

leo: can you paste an example request header? curious which fields are leaking through to the quota layer.

sam: here's an example from the trace (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer svc-token-xxx
X-Delegation-Chain: org:org-alpha,proj:proj-42 -> sa:ingest-service
X-Delegation-Meta: origin_project=proj-42;origin_org=org-alpha;path=/ingest
User-Agent: rwinf-client/2.4
```

tariq: OK that explains it — our quota attribution code currently prefers the immediate token owner (the service token) when the delegation headers exist. we intended to fall back to origin_project, but a small ordering bug prevents parsing when `X-Delegation-Meta` is present and empty-ish.

nina: so the fix is to normalize X-Delegation-Meta and prefer origin_* keys, then map to project quota? also need a console surface for admins to see the delegation chain and which project got billed.

leo: +1. two pieces: (1) runtime fix — normalize and canonicalize keys (lowercase, split on `;`, trim). (2) telemetry & UX — add a `delegation_chain` field to traces and a `attribution_decision` tag so console can show "billed_to: proj-42 (source: origin_project)" vs "billed_to: ingest-service (token)". we should keep both for audits.

sam: agree. runtime patch is highest priority. can we do a quick canary in prod behind a flag? we have some heavy customers so we need to avoid regressions.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: authz-proxy v2.1.3 -> canary cluster (3 pods) at 2026-03-21T04:12:00Z

tariq: i'll send a small patch to the parser and wire up a feature flag `preserve_origin_attribution`. default=false during canary, but we can turn on for 2 orgs. also will add an invariant test for malformed meta.

nina: for console — UX suggestion: show "Attribution preview" in request inspector with both raw headers and normalized attribution. admin toggle to enforce origin attribution as billing source (with audit warning).

leo: telemetry note: we must be careful with cardinality. `delegation_chain` can explode if we emit raw strings. recommend emitting structured tags: `delegation_depth` (int), `origin_org` (low-cardinality), `origin_project` (medium), and a hashed `delegation_signature` for debug linking to full logs stored separately.

sam: hmm good point. hashing full chain + keeping sample traces with full string. also add an event when we flip attribution decision (old->new) so downstream billing pipelines can reconcile.

tariq: plan: patch -> canary -> enable flag for orgs (org-alpha + org-beta) -> monitor `billed_to` tag distribution + SLOs -> roll out. estimated ETA for patch PR: 2h. I'll open it now.

ops-bot: alert suppressed for quota-spike-042 while canary is in progress. monitoring rule now samples attribution metrics.

leo: after rollout we should run a nightly job to scan for inconsistent billing (token owner vs origin_project) and backfill logs for misattributed windows.

sam: thanks team. keep the thread updated with PR link and canary metrics. :thumbsup:
